ei.title: Social Media as a Vital E-commerce Platform
ei.subject: 수능특강

fullPassage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a significant milestone that enabled it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family. But with the popularity of some platforms, social media has turned into a vital tool for businesses seeking to sell their products online. Social media is now used by businesses to promote their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers. Influencer marketing is another way that social media has evolved into a platform for businesses. Influencers are those users who have a sizable social media following and are recognized as authorities or thought leaders in their specialized field. Influencer marketing allows businesses to reach the users' followers, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people they follow on social media.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform ①<u>is</u> a significant milestone that ②<u>enabling</u> it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly ③<u>used</u> for communication with friends and family. But with the popularity of some platforms, social media has turned into a vital tool for businesses ④<u>seeking</u> to sell their products online. Social media is now used by businesses to promote their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers. Influencer marketing is another way that social media has evolved into a platform for businesses. Influencers are those users who have a sizable social media following and are recognized as authorities or thought leaders in their specialized field. Influencer marketing allows businesses to reach the users' followers, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people they follow on social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② enabling → enabled: 선행사 milestone을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that절의 동사 자리이므로 과거형 enabled가 와야 한다. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① is: 주어 Social media's transformation(단수)에 대한 단수 동사 is는 올바른 어법
❌ ② enabling → enabled: 'a significant milestone that ___ it to become ~'에서 that은 주격 관계대명사이고 그 절의 본동사 자리이므로 현재분사 enabling이 아니라 과거형 enabled가 필요
✅ ③ used: 과거시제 수동태 was used의 과거분사로 올바른 어법
✅ ④ seeking: 앞의 businesses를 뒤에서 수식하는 현재분사(능동: 찾고 있는)로 올바른 어법
det.tip: 주격 관계대명사 that 뒤에는 선행사에 대응되는 본동사가 와야 합니다. 분사형(-ing)은 본동사 자리를 대신할 수 없습니다.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a significant milestone that enabled it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family. But with the popularity of some platforms, social media has turned into a vital tool for businesses seeking ①<u>to sell</u> their products online. Social media is now used by businesses ②<u>promoting</u> their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers. Influencer marketing is another way that social media has evolved into a platform for businesses. Influencers are those users who have a sizable social media following and are ③<u>recognized</u> as authorities or thought leaders in their specialized field. Influencer marketing allows businesses ④<u>to reach</u> the users' followers, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people they follow on social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ② promoting → to promote: 'is used by businesses ___ their products'에서 'be used to V(~하는 데 사용되다)' 구조의 to부정사 자리이므로 to promote가 와야 한다. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① to sell: 'businesses seeking to sell ~'에서 동사 seek의 목적어로 to부정사 to sell은 올바른 어법
❌ ② promoting → to promote: 'be used to V(~하는 데 사용되다)' 구조이며 뒤의 'as well as provide'가 동사원형 provide와 병렬을 이루려면 앞도 to부정사 to promote가 와야 함. promoting은 'be used to V-ing(~에 익숙하다)' 의미가 되어 문맥과 맞지 않음
✅ ③ recognized: 주어 Influencers에 대해 'are recognized as ~(~로 인정받다)'의 수동태 과거분사로 올바른 어법
✅ ④ to reach: 'allows businesses to V(기업이 ~하도록 허용하다)'의 5형식 목적격보어 자리로 올바른 어법
det.tip: be used to + 동사원형(to V) = '~하는 데 사용되다', be used to + V-ing = '~에 익숙하다'. 두 구조를 구별하세요.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a significant milestone ①<u>that enabled</u> it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family. But with the popularity of some platforms, social media ②<u>has turned</u> into a vital tool for businesses seeking to sell their products online. Social media is now used by businesses to promote their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers. Influencer marketing is another way that social media has evolved into a platform for businesses. Influencers are those users ③<u>whom have</u> a sizable social media following and are recognized as authorities or thought leaders in their specialized field. Influencer marketing allows businesses to reach the users' followers, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people ④<u>they follow</u> on social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 어법상 틀린 것은?

det.korean: ③ whom have → who have: 관계사절 안에서 동사 have의 주어 역할을 하므로 주격 관계대명사 who가 와야 한다. 목적격 whom은 동사의 주어 자리에 쓸 수 없다. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① that enabled: 선행사 milestone을 수식하는 주격 관계대명사 that과 그 절의 본동사 enabled는 올바른 어법
✅ ② has turned: 'with the popularity of some platforms' 이후 현재에 이르기까지의 변화를 나타내는 현재완료 has turned는 올바른 어법
❌ ③ whom have → who have: 'those users ___ have a sizable social media following'에서 관계대명사는 뒤 동사 have의 주어 역할이므로 주격 who가 필요. 목적격 whom은 주어 자리에 올 수 없음
✅ ④ they follow: 'people (whom/that) they follow on social media'에서 목적격 관계대명사가 생략되고 주어 they + 타동사 follow로 이어지는 올바른 어법
det.tip: 관계대명사 뒤에 '동사'가 바로 오면 주격(who), '주어+동사'가 오면 목적격(whom/that). 주어 자리에 whom은 절대 불가.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a ①<u>significant</u> milestone that enabled it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family. But with the popularity of some platforms, social media has turned into a ②<u>vital</u> tool for businesses seeking to sell their products online. Social media is now used by businesses to ③<u>conceal</u> their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers. Influencer marketing is another way that social media has evolved into a platform for businesses. Influencers are those users who have a ④<u>sizable</u> social media following and are recognized as authorities or thought leaders in their specialized field. Influencer marketing allows businesses to reach the users' followers, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people they follow on social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ③ conceal → promote: 기업이 소셜 미디어로 '제품을 홍보하고' 직접 쇼핑 옵션까지 제공한다는 문맥이므로 '숨기다'의 conceal은 정반대. 원문의 promote가 적절. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① significant: 전자상거래 플랫폼으로의 전환이 '중요한' 이정표라는 문맥에 적절
✅ ② vital: 소셜 미디어가 기업에 있어 '필수적인' 도구가 되었다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ conceal → promote: 뒤의 'as well as provide a direct shopping option'과 연결되어 '제품을 홍보하고 + 직접 쇼핑 옵션 제공'이 병렬되는 구조이므로 '홍보하다(promote)'가 맞음. '숨기다(conceal)'는 판매 맥락과 정반대
✅ ④ sizable: 인플루언서가 '상당한 규모의' 팔로워를 보유한다는 문맥에 적절
det.tip: 어휘 문제는 앞뒤 문장의 논리 방향(긍정↔부정)을 먼저 확인하세요. 판매/홍보 맥락에서 '숨기다'는 논리 역전입니다.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a significant milestone that enabled it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family. But with the ①<u>popularity</u> of some platforms, social media has turned into a vital tool for businesses seeking to sell their products online. Social media is now used by businesses to promote their products and offerings as well as provide a ②<u>direct</u> shopping option for buyers. Influencer marketing is another way that social media has evolved into a platform for businesses. Influencers are those users who have a sizable social media following and are recognized as ③<u>authorities</u> or thought leaders in their specialized field. Influencer marketing allows businesses to reach the users' followers, who are more likely to ④<u>doubt</u> suggestions from people they follow on social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 밑줄 친 ①~④ 중, 문맥상 낱말의 쓰임이 적절하지 않은 것은?

det.korean: ④ doubt → trust: 팔로워가 자신이 팔로우하는 사람들의 추천을 '신뢰할' 가능성이 더 높다는 문맥이므로 '의심하다(doubt)'는 정반대. 원문의 trust가 적절. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① popularity: 일부 플랫폼의 '인기' 덕분에 소셜 미디어가 기업용 도구로 전환되었다는 흐름에 적절
✅ ② direct: 기업이 구매자에게 '직접적인' 쇼핑 옵션을 제공한다는 문맥에 적절
✅ ③ authorities: 인플루언서가 전문 분야에서 'or thought leaders'와 병렬되는 '권위자'로 인정받는다는 문맥에 적절
❌ ④ doubt → trust: 마지막 문장은 인플루언서 마케팅의 효과 근거로 '팔로워들이 자신이 팔로우하는 사람들의 추천을 신뢰할 가능성이 높다'는 점을 제시. '의심하다(doubt)'로 바꾸면 인플루언서 마케팅이 효과적이라는 본문의 결론과 정반대가 됨
det.tip: 마지막 문장은 인플루언서 마케팅의 효과를 정당화하는 논거입니다. 긍정적 신뢰를 뒤집은 어휘가 정답입니다.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a significant milestone that enabled it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family. But with the popularity of some platforms, social media has turned into a __________ tool for businesses seeking to sell their products online. Social media is now used by businesses to promote their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers. Influencer marketing is another way that social media has evolved into a platform for businesses. Influencers are those users who have a sizable social media following and are recognized as authorities or thought leaders in their specialized field. Influencer marketing allows businesses to reach the users' followers, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people they follow on social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ① vital ← 정답. 뒤의 '기업이 제품을 온라인에서 판매하려고 찾는(seeking to sell their products online)' 도구라는 설명과, 글 전체가 소셜 미디어의 상업적 필수성(e-commerce platform, tool for businesses)을 강조한다는 점에서 '필수적인(vital)'이 가장 적절하다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① vital(필수적인): 기업의 온라인 판매를 위한 '필수' 도구라는 맥락에 부합. 본문 주제(상업적 필수성)와 일치
❌ ② significant(중요한): 1문장에서 'significant milestone(중요한 이정표)'로 쓰인 어휘. '이정표'에는 어울리나 '도구' 앞에서는 판매 맥락의 필수성·생존 필요성까지 함축하지 못함. 빈칸 뒤 'seeking to sell'의 적극적 상업 활용과는 약한 결합
❌ ③ direct(직접적인): 4문장에서 'direct shopping option'으로 쓰인 어휘. 쇼핑 옵션의 매개 없음은 설명하나, tool 자체의 '필수성' 속성을 설명할 수 없음
❌ ④ specialized(전문화된): 6문장에서 인플루언서의 specialized field로 쓰인 어휘. 인플루언서의 분야 특성이지 '도구'의 일반적 상업 필수성을 나타내지 못함
det.tip: 빈칸 바로 뒤 'tool for businesses seeking to sell their products online'은 적극적 상업 활용을 의미하므로 긍정·필수성을 나타내는 형용사를 고르세요.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a significant milestone that enabled it to become a platform for organizations. Influencer marketing allows businesses to reach the users' followers, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people they follow on social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: ④ authorities ← 정답. 빈칸 뒤 'or thought leaders in their specialized field(전문 분야의 사고 리더)'와 or로 병렬되며, 인플루언서가 전문 분야에서 영향력을 인정받는다는 맥락에 맞는 '권위자(authorities)'가 가장 적절하다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① followers: 뒤 문장에서 인플루언서가 보유한 대상으로 이미 언급됨. 인플루언서 자신을 '팔로워'로 인정한다는 것은 논리 파탄
❌ ② buyers: 본문에서 buyers는 기업이 상품을 제공하는 대상이므로 인플루언서와 동일시될 수 없음
❌ ③ organizations: 1문장에서 소셜 미디어가 조직을 위한 플랫폼이 되었다는 맥락이며 인플루언서 개인을 지칭하지 않음
✅ ④ authorities: or로 연결된 thought leaders(사고 리더)와 같은 의미장으로 '권위자'가 적절. 전문 분야에서 인정받는다는 흐름과 일치
det.tip: 빈칸 주변의 병렬 연결어(or, and)를 보세요. 'or thought leaders'와 병렬되려면 전문성·영향력을 함의하는 명사가 와야 합니다.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a significant milestone that enabled it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family. But with the popularity of some platforms, social media has turned into a vital tool for businesses seeking to sell their products online. Influencer marketing allows businesses to reach the users' followers, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people they follow on social media.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하지 않는 것은?

det.korean: ② 본문은 'Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family'라고 하여 초기에는 친구·가족과의 소통에 주로 쓰였다고 밝힌다. 따라서 '처음부터 주로 기업의 상품 판매를 위해 사용되었다'는 진술은 본문과 반대이다. ← 정답
det.analysis:
✅ ① 1문장과 일치: 전자상거래 플랫폼으로의 전환이 조직용 플랫폼이 되게 한 중요한 이정표
❌ ② 2문장과 불일치: 초기·주로 친구·가족 소통용이었다가 이후 기업 도구로 전환됨. 본문 진술을 뒤집은 오답
✅ ③ 4문장과 일치: 'promote their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers'
✅ ④ 5문장과 일치: 'Influencer marketing is another way that social media has evolved into a platform for businesses'
det.tip: '초기·처음(initially)'과 '지금·현재(now)'의 시간 대비가 있는 글은 시점을 뒤집은 선지를 의심하세요.

ch: 소셜 미디어의 전자상거래 플랫폼으로의 전환은 조직을 위한 플랫폼이 되도록 한 중요한 이정표이다.
소셜 미디어는 처음부터 주로 기업의 상품 판매를 위해 사용되었다.
기업은 소셜 미디어를 통해 제품을 홍보할 뿐만 아니라 구매자에게 직접 쇼핑 옵션을 제공한다.
인플루언서 마케팅은 소셜 미디어가 기업용 플랫폼으로 진화한 또 하나의 방식이다.

questions.passage: Social media's transformation into an e-commerce platform is a significant milestone that enabled it to become a platform for organizations. Social media was initially and mainly used for communication with friends and family. But with the popularity of some platforms, social media has turned into a vital tool for businesses seeking to sell their products online. Social media is now used by businesses to promote their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers. questions.stem: 다음 글의 내용과 일치하는 것은?

det.korean: ③ 본문 4문장 'Social media is now used by businesses to promote their products and offerings as well as provide a direct shopping option for buyers'와 일치한다. ← 정답
det.analysis:
❌ ① 1문장 'enabled it to become a platform for organizations'와 반대
❌ ② 3문장 'with the popularity of some platforms'로, 쇠퇴가 아니라 '인기' 덕분에 전환됨
✅ ③ 4문장과 일치: 제품 홍보 + 구매자에게 직접 쇼핑 옵션 제공
❌ ④ 6문장 'recognized as authorities or thought leaders in their specialized field'와 반대로, 전문 분야의 권위자·사고 리더
det.tip: 선지마다 본문의 어느 문장에 대응되는지 먼저 찾고, 원인·시점·극성(긍정/부정)이 뒤집혔는지 확인하세요.

ch: 소셜 미디어는 전자상거래 플랫폼으로 전환되었으나 조직을 위한 플랫폼이 되지는 못했다.

Influencers are those users who have a sizable social media following and are recognized as authorities or thought leaders in their specialized field. Influencer marketing __________, who are more likely to trust suggestions from people they follow on social media.
